CAUTION on the doe_award correction: the award was cancelled. battery-tech.net (https://battery-tech.net/battery-markets-news/doe-cancels-720m-in-battery-grants-under-bipartisan-law/, Oct 21, 2025) names Anovion among DOE's roughly $720M of cancelled Bipartisan Infrastructure Law grants, says $117 million had been awarded and only $13.8 million released to date. Facility status stays 'announced': the page supports nothing newer, and a company profile (not opened) says construction began late 2024.
